opencode.verification: OpenCode 2.1.2 serves GET /api/model as { location, data: Model.Info[] } with variants as [{ id, settings }], and GET /api/integration as { location, data: Integration.Info[] } with connections [{ type: env | credential, status? }]. The discovery server runs over OPENCODE_DB=:memory:, so it sees environment connections only: no saved credential, no session, nothing to resume.

agy.verification: Native 1.2.16 printmode.run authenticates before built-in metadata reports; 1.2.17 returns the identical /config and exact-ID /model JSON envelopes (SUCCESS, empty conversation_id, zero turns, all usage counters zero) and exits 0 once stdin is closed; effective empty provider is the default Google account transport, gemini is the explicit Google API-key transport. Custom models, GCP and custom endpoints are not established by this binding.
